src.ui.widgets.graphs¶

Graphs display module

Functions¶

display_monthly_arrival_delay_graph(→ None)

Display a graph of monthly mean arrival delays

Module Contents¶

src.ui.widgets.graphs.display_monthly_arrival_delay_graph(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, start_month: int, end_month: int, selected_years: list[int], actual_year: int = 2026) → None¶

Display a graph of monthly mean arrival delays for a selected railway line.

Compare the monthly mean delays of the actual year with the median of the monthly mean delays from selected previous years.

The graph also displays historical minimum, maximum and quartiles, when enough observations are available. The months selected by the user are highlighted.

Parameters:

  • departure_station (str) – departure railway station

  • arrival_station (str) – arrival railway station

  • start_month (int) – first month of the selected period (included)

  • end_month (int) – last month of the selected period (included)

  • selected_years (list[int]) – years selected by the user. The actual year wil be excluded from historical calculations if needed.

  • actual_year (int, optional) – year whose observations are compared with the historical distribution. Defaults to 2026.
